title: 第25章 玉中灵第26章 再杀
content_zh:
他发现一个令他吃惊的事情。
在通天法界的加持下，他的神识不仅能覆盖洞内，还能从洞口延伸出去很远。
而经过一轮炼化过后，韩林发现山洞外面的灵气，依旧没有恢复。
可这山洞内的灵气，却在短短的一刻钟内，就重新恢复如初了！这般恢复速度，简直不合常理。
要知道，通天法界内一刻钟，外界才过去五十息左右而已！天地灵气怎会恢复的如此之快？
以前在别的地方，没有个半个时辰，那是不可能恢复的！
韩林思来想去也不明白其中缘故，只当这里是一处天然的修炼宝地！于是摇摇头，又继续修炼了起来。
夜色如墨。
归元山脉大部分地方都显得静悄悄的。
但在某处云雾深笼的石山外面，却忽然飞来一道剑光。上面站着一名英姿挺拔的紫袍中年。
剑光在半空之上微微一顿，随即斜斜向下，钻入云雾，落在石山脚下的一个洞口外面。
洞口上方，赫然写着藏宝洞三个大字。
一名盘膝而坐的青年豁然睁开双眼，当看到来人模样时，神色一惊地站了起来：“拜见掌教！”
掌教？此人竟是归元宗掌教，玉孤城！
“嗯。”
玉孤城淡淡回应了一下，就大步朝山洞内部走去。
里面通道并不宽阔，而且弯来拐去，沿途还有许多岔道，但玉孤城都没有停留，直到来到一个悬挂着‘矿石区’的洞门前，才终于停下脚步。
洞门没关，可以看到里面空间十分开阔，有一位头发斑白的老人，盘坐在地上，面朝一块巨大无比的青花玉。
似乎感应到玉孤城的到来，老人回头看了一眼，连忙起身相迎：“掌教，您来了。”
“这就是你说的那块巨型青花玉？”玉孤城走过去，盯着地上巨大无比的玉石，一脸惊奇。

“正是。”
“确实罕见啊，自青龙河矿材开采以来，还从未出现过如此巨大的青花玉吧？”玉孤城围着玉石缓缓转圈，惊叹不已。
“是啊，当初老夫听说此事，还觉得是那刘知虎在吹牛，结果亲眼见到时也是狠狠地震惊了一把呢。”
老人笑着点点头，“掌教，如此巨大的青花玉，若是交给百煅堂炼制成普通玉符，无疑是有点浪费啊？您打算如何处理呢。”
玉孤城摇头道：“这个我也没想好，就暂且留在藏宝洞吧，等将来想到了再……”
玉孤城正说着，余光之中忽然看到玉石某处，闪过一道紫芒。
但等他转头看去时，却又平静如常。
“掌教，怎么了？”
老人见状露出疑惑之色。
玉孤城皱了皱眉头，“你刚才有没有看到，这玉石好像亮了一道紫光？”
“紫光？不可能吧，青花玉怎么会亮紫光呢。”
“那倒也是，或许是我眼花了。”
玉孤城又盯着玉石看了两眼，“行了刘老，此玉就留在此地吧，我先走了。”
“恭送掌教。”
老人弯腰相送。
等到玉孤城出门而去，他又再次盘坐在地上，闭目修炼了起来。
但是还没过多久，耳边就忽然响起响起咔嚓一声，老人神色一惊地睁开双眼。
竟看到眼前的玉石表面，浮现出一道裂纹。
嚓，嚓，嚓嚓嚓……。
随着第一道裂纹出现，仿佛连锁反应一样，玉石表面的裂纹突然飞速扩张起来。
content_en:
He discovered something that surprised him.
With the blessing of the Tongtian Dharma Realm, his consciousness can not only cover the inside of the cave, but can also extend far from the entrance of the cave.
After a round of refining, Han Lin found that the aura outside the cave still had not recovered.
But the spiritual energy in the cave returned to its original state in just a quarter of an hour! This recovery speed is simply unreasonable.
You know, within a quarter of an hour in the Tongtian Dharma Realm, only about fifty breaths have passed outside the world! How could the spiritual energy of heaven and earth recover so quickly?
In other places before, without half an hour, it would have been impossible to recover!
Han Lin didn't understand the reason even after thinking about it. He just thought that this was a natural cultivation treasure place! So he shook his head and continued practicing.
The night is as dark as ink.
Most places in the Guiyuan Mountains seemed quiet.
But somewhere outside the stone mountain shrouded in clouds and mist, a sword light suddenly flew over. Standing on it was a tall and handsome middle-aged man in purple robe.
The sword light paused for a moment in mid-air, then slanted downwards, penetrated into the clouds and mist, and landed outside a cave at the foot of the stone mountain.
Above the entrance of the cave, the three characters "Treasure Cave" are clearly written.
A young man sitting cross-legged suddenly opened his eyes. When he saw the appearance of the person, he stood up in surprise: "Greetings to the master!"
Headmaster? This person is actually the headmaster of Guiyuan Sect, Yu Gucheng!
"Yeah."
Yu Gucheng responded lightly and strode towards the inside of the cave.
The passage inside was not wide and winding, with many forks along the way, but Yugucheng did not stop until he came to a cave door with the word "Ore Area" hanging on it, and finally stopped.
The cave door is open, and you can see that the space inside is very open. There is an old man with gray hair sitting cross-legged on the ground, facing a huge blue and white jade.
As if sensing Yu Gucheng's arrival, the old man looked back and quickly stood up to greet him: "Headmaster, you are here."
"Is this the giant blue and white jade you were talking about?" Yu Gucheng walked over and stared at the huge jade on the ground with a look of surprise.
"Exactly."
"It is indeed rare. Since the mining of Qinglong River minerals, such a huge blue and white jade has never appeared, right?" Yu Gucheng slowly circled around the jade and was amazed.
"Yes, when I heard about this, I thought Liu Zhihu was bragging. But when I saw it with my own eyes, I was shocked."
The old man smiled and nodded, "Master, if such a huge blue and white jade is handed over to Bai Xuan Hall to be refined into an ordinary jade talisman, it would undoubtedly be a bit of a waste? What do you plan to do with it?"
Yu Gucheng shook his head and said: "I haven't thought about this yet, so I'll just stay in the treasure cave for now, and wait until I think about it in the future..."
As Yu Gucheng was talking, he suddenly saw a purple light flashing somewhere on the jade stone in his peripheral vision.
But when he turned around to look, he was calm as usual.
"Headmaster, what's wrong?"
The old man looked puzzled when he saw this.
Yu Gucheng frowned, "Did you see just now that the jade seemed to shine with a purple light?"
"Purple light? It's impossible. How can blue and white jade shine purple?"
"That's true, maybe I'm dazzled."
Yu Gucheng stared at the jade stone again and said, "Okay, Mr. Liu, let this jade stay here. I'll leave first."
"Congratulations to the Headmaster."
The old man bent down to see him off.
After Yu Gucheng left, he sat cross-legged on the ground again, closed his eyes and started practicing.
But not long after, there was a sudden click in his ears, and the old man opened his eyes in shock.
He actually saw a crack appearing on the surface of the jade in front of him.
Thump, thump, thump, thump….
As the first crack appeared, like a chain reaction, the cracks on the surface of the jade suddenly expanded rapidly.
